sentences.s: Traditionally, legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.

trunk.宾语或表语: the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person
trunk.主干翻译: 法律知识一直被视为律师们所专有的，而不是一个受教育者知识素养的必要组成部分。

components.原文: Traditionally
components.说明: 副词置于句首作时间状语，修饰谓语。

components.原文: in such institutions
components.说明: 介词短语作地点状语，such institutions 回指上文提到的加拿大院校。

components.原文: rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person
components.中文翻译: 而不是一个受教育者知识素养的必要组成部分
components.说明: 并列连词 rather than 连接 be viewed as 后的两个主语补足语，否定后者、侧重二者差异。

components.原文: of the intellectual equipment of an educated person
components.说明: of 介词结构作后置定语，修饰 a necessary part；equipment 为熟词僻义，指才能、知识素养。

sentences.zh: 长久以来，法律知识在这类学校里一直被视为律师们所专有的，而不是一个受教育者的知识素养的必要组成部分。

sentences.s: On the other, it links these concepts to everyday realities in a manner which is parallel to the links journalists forge on a daily basis as they cover and comment on the news.

trunk.主干翻译: 另一方面，这一学科把这些概念结合到日常生活中。

components.原文: On the other
components.说明: 与上文 On the one hand 呼应的衔接语，引出并列的另一功能。

components.原文: to everyday realities
components.说明: 与谓语构成 link ... to ... 结构，作动词的宾语补足状语。

components.原文: in a manner
components.说明: 介词短语作方式状语，后接定语从句加以说明。

components.原文: which is parallel to the links
components.中文翻译: 这种方式与……建立联系是相同的
components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 manner，be parallel to 表示两者一致。

components.原文: journalists forge on a daily basis
components.中文翻译: 新闻记者每天建立的（联系）
components.说明: 嵌套的定语从句，关系代词 that 被省略，forge 的宾语即 the links，on a daily basis 作状语。

components.原文: as they cover and comment on the news
components.中文翻译: 当他们报道和评论新闻时
components.说明: as 引导时间状语从句，cover 为熟词僻义，与 news 搭配意为报道。

sentences.zh: 另一方面，这一学科把这些概念结合到日常生活中，这与新闻记者每天报道和评论新闻时的做法是相同的。

sentences.s: But the idea that the journalist must understand the law more profoundly than an ordinary citizen rests on an understanding of the established conventions and special responsibilities of the news media.

trunk.宾语或表语: an understanding of the established conventions and special responsibilities of the news media
trunk.主干翻译: 但这种看法是基于对新闻媒体业已确立的规约和特殊责任的理解。

components.原文: But
components.说明: 转折连词，引出与上文通俗观点的对比评价。

components.原文: that the journalist must understand the law more profoundly than an ordinary citizen
components.中文翻译: 新闻记者应比普通公民更加透彻地了解法律
components.说明: that 引导同位语从句说明 the idea 的具体内容；从句过长，翻译时前置独立成句、再用代词复指。

components.原文: than an ordinary citizen
components.说明: than 引导比较状语，与 more profoundly 构成比较结构。

components.原文: of the established conventions and special responsibilities of the news media
components.中文翻译: 对……业已确立的规约和特殊责任的
components.说明: of 介词结构作后置定语，修饰 an understanding。

components.原文: of the news media
components.修饰对象: the established conventions and special responsibilities
components.说明: of 介词结构作后置定语，修饰 established conventions and special responsibilities。

sentences.zh: 新闻记者应比普通公民更加透彻地了解法律，而这种看法是基于他们对新闻媒体业已确立的规约和特殊责任的理解。

sentences.s: In fact, it is difficult to see how journalists who do not have a clear grasp of the basic features of the Canadian Constitution can do a competent job on political stories.

components.原文: In fact
components.说明: 句首衔接语，承接上文引出例证。

components.成分类型: 非谓语(不定式作真正主语)
components.原文: to see how journalists who do not have a clear grasp of the basic features of the Canadian Constitution can do a competent job on political stories
components.中文翻译: 想象……记者何以能胜任……工作
components.说明: it 为形式主语，此不定式结构为真正主语，因过长而后置。

components.原文: how journalists who do not have a clear grasp of the basic features of the Canadian Constitution can do a competent job on political stories
components.中文翻译: 那些记者何以能胜任政治新闻报道工作
components.说明: how 引导宾语从句作 see 的宾语。

components.原文: who do not have a clear grasp of the basic features of the Canadian Constitution
components.中文翻译: 那些对加拿大宪法的基本特点缺乏清晰了解的
components.说明: who 引导定语从句修饰 journalists，可译为前置定语。

sentences.zh: 事实上，很难想象那些对加拿大宪法的基本特点缺乏清晰了解的新闻记者何以能胜任政治新闻的报道工作。

sentences.s: While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories, it is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.

trunk.主干翻译: 新闻记者最好自行做出判断。

components.原文: While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories
components.中文翻译: 尽管律师的见解和反应会提高报道的质量
components.说明: While 引导让步状语从句，先肯定律师建议的作用，再由主句强调记者应自行判断。

components.原文: from lawyers
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 comment and reaction。

components.原文: for journalists
components.修饰对象: to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments
components.说明: for 介词结构表示后接不定式的逻辑主语。

components.成分类型: 非谓语(不定式作真正主语)
components.原文: to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments
components.中文翻译: 凭借自己对重要性的理解自行做出判断
components.说明: it 为形式主语，此不定式并列结构为真正主语。

sentences.zh: 尽管律师的见解和反应会提高报道的质量，但新闻记者最好凭借他们自己对重要性的理解自行做出判断。
